# [1.0.21](https://github.com/semicoloncolonel/mobile-morphe-patches/releases/tag/v1.0.21) (2026-11-16)

The stable Android TV patches from mobile-morphe-patches v1.0.21, as their own source. They are the same patches and app versions as that release.

Hulu (Android TV) is not in this release, because its patches are still in testing. The pre-release channel has them.

Built from [mobile-morphe-patches v1.0.21](https://github.com/semicoloncolonel/mobile-morphe-patches/releases/tag/v1.0.21).

patches.name: Auto-skip (Android TV)
patches.description: Presses Skip for you on the parts you choose: Apple's promos for other titles, recaps, and intros.

options.description: Skips Apple's promos for other titles that play before a show or movie.
Skips the recap of earlier episodes.

patches.name: Block analytics & tracking (Android TV)
patches.description: Reduces Apple's usage metrics and stops playback reports in the Android TV app. The app also stops downloading updates to its screens between app updates.

patches.description: Stops the review prompt from Google Play in the Android TV app.
